description.p: GoreeCloud Memos is the first-party Linux client for the privacy-first, self-hosted GoreeCloud Memos service.

It provides a constrained native shell around the canonical GoreeCloud Memos web application while preserving the same Glaze UI experience, authentication, authorization, data protection, and Wardveil Security controls.

Refreshes the native acceptance package for the current post-v0.1.3 GoreeCloud Memos source line, including the responsive Home masonry work and later usability improvements, while preserving the constrained thin-client boundary and separate server deployment acceptance.

Refreshes exact-head Linux and Android acceptance packaging for the current stabilized client source, strengthens package version and provenance checks, and preserves the canonical GoreeCloud Memos identity and hardened native boundary.

Unifies Debian installer metadata with the canonical GoreeCloud Memos app identity, adds complete AppStream license and release information, and retains the hardened Glaze UI, Wardveil Security, and native client boundary.
